title: Document live public walkthrough account
summary: README now documents the live production public walkthrough account so operators and QA can sign in through public login without using a superadmin session.
changes: Added a Live public walkthrough account (production) section to README with account identity, separation rules, and operator secret-store guidance.
Recorded that local QA seeds remain local/testing-only and that Staff Login or directory sync must never own the live walkthrough account.
version_rationale: Patch release for operator documentation only; no application code or runtime behaviour changed.
validation: Live walkthrough account verified on production: public login succeeds, public hubs return 200, and admin or superadmin routes return 403.
Production identity confirmed as local service-user with no OIDC subject; myapes:accounts:check remained green.
known_limitations: Walkthrough account credentials are stored only in the operator secret store; public password reset remains tracked separately in issue #121.
rollback: Revert README and release metadata; the live walkthrough account row in production is unaffected by this documentation-only release.
